name: Musume yo... Aru Fushikatei no 1 Shuukan
original_name: 娘よ…… ある父子家庭の1週間
source:
A father who's wife has passed away lays eyes on his daughter pleasuring herself,
and a desire shut away in his innermost heart is unexpectedly awakened.

In the end, what fate will be visited upon this father and child...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE144065.html]DLsite English[/url]]
